hierarchy_metrics_note: Frozen Iteration 8 research metrics (FILR, TGA, ancestor retention, under/over-forgetting, wrong-branch, refusal, hallucination, route/type/depth strata). TEST split is the PRIMARY basis; 'pooled' is secondary. These are the metrics Iteration 9's MF->MU baselines will be compared on (central comparison: MU ~= MG with retained non-target knowledge).

definition.fine_recovery: MF > MG and MF > MN by >= 0.15 (baseline accuracy, adversarial excluded)
definition.target_abstraction: MG > MN by >= 0.15 on target_core post-unlearning accuracy
definition.retain: all states >= 0.5 on same-entity and other-entity retain accuracy
